name: Anki
audience: Medical students, language learners, dedicated power users who value control.
positioning: The original open-source spaced repetition flashcard app; maximal control, minimal polish.
weaknesses: No AI generation of cards from PDFs/YouTube
No notes, mind maps, podcasts, or summaries
Mobile sync/AppStore versions are paid by maintainer
recentAiFeatures: Community add-ons for AI; no first-party AI generation of study artifacts.
pricingNote: Desktop free; iOS app is paid as the maintainer's funding model; do not quote prices.
commonPraise: The scheduler just works; reliable long-term retention; huge shared decks; configurable.
commonComplaints: Hard to start; ugly interface; you must author every card yourself; no AI assistance.
positioningVsNomi: Anki is the scheduler to beat for power users who author cards by hand; Nomi generates the cards (notes, flashcards, quizzes, podcasts) for you and adds spaced repetition so you're not stuck writing every card.
